name: Air-Fryer Paneer Popcorn
ingredients: 150 g low-fat paneer, cut in small cubes
½ tsp each chilli powder, garlic powder and chaat masala
steps: Toss the paneer cubes with the spices and salt.
Add the besan, cornflour and water to coat lightly.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C and spray the basket.
Cook for 8–10 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp and golden.
Serve with mint chutney and lemon.
note: Over 25 g protein from about 150 g of paneer.
